title: App with the drive.file scope cannot see a Sheet created by hand
symptoms: 404 File not found for a file that exists
Files created in the browser are invisible to the app
cause: The drive.file scope only reaches files the app itself created or was explicitly given through a picker. In exchange it avoids restricted scope verification.
fix: Have the app's setup script create the Sheets and folders it needs.
apply: Create the file through the API with the same OAuth client, then store its id for later runs.
